source_package.name: arctic-climate-utac / antarctic-ice-shelf-utac
source_package.ported_note: Summary statistics copied from both packages' constants.py. Year-by-year ice-extent curves are a schematic reconstruction calibrated to the published endpoint values, not raw satellite data.

primary_sources.authors: Duspayev, A., Flanner, M., Riihelä, A. et al.
primary_sources.title: Earth's Sea Ice Radiative Effect From 1980 to 2023

primary_sources.authors: Zhang, H., Storto, A., Bai, X., Yang, C.
primary_sources.title: Quantifying the interplay of sea ice meltwater and ice-albedo feedbacks in the Arctic ice-ocean system

primary_sources.authors: Riihelä, A., Bright, R.M., Anttila, K.
primary_sources.title: Recent strengthening of snow and ice albedo feedback driven by Antarctic sea-ice loss

verified_quantities.name: GAMMA_IA
verified_quantities.source: Zhang et al. 2025; albedo feedback ~2x competing meltwater feedback

verified_quantities.name: POST_REVERSAL_COMBINED_W_M2
verified_quantities.source: Riihelä et al. 2021, 2016-2018 combined Arctic+Antarctic 3-year mean

tipping.derived_from: Riihelä et al. 2021, documented sign flip of the Antarctic sea-ice-albedo feedback

regen.derived_from: No relaxation/recovery quantity is defined for a feedback-sign flip in the source literature -- left undefined rather than guessed.

formula_ref: physics.ts sireFromIceRel(): SIRE scales ~iceRel^2 (piecewise-linear approximation), no shared ODE between hemispheres
disclaimer: Zahlen sind aus arctic-climate-utac und antarctic-ice-shelf-utac kopiert, nicht erfunden. Die Jahresverlaufskurven sind schematisch an publizierte Eckwerte kalibriert, keine Satelliten-Rohdaten.
